name: Arrow Station
_stockNote: Structure health. Towers are destructible (ADR-0006) -- gold spent can be lost, which is what stops income compounding into permanent power.
_repairNote: Percent of the sell-and-rebuild cost to repair from zero to full. 100 is the wall -- at or above it nobody would ever repair -- and the loader refuses to load a def that reaches it (ADR-0007). Too LOW and no tower ever dies, which silently reverts tower-combat; that end is measured, not enforced.
_upgradeRule: Rising cost, FALLING damage-per-gold. Building must stay the efficient play while good spots remain, or mazing stops mattering (design spec, The central tension).
_untuned: Placeholder values. No balance pass has run. See content-data/docs/balance-targets.md.
